array.string: set -a; source "{{CONFIG}}"; set +a; export MULTICA_SERVER_URL="http://127.0.0.1:${MULTICA_BOARD_BACKEND_PORT}" MULTICA_APP_URL="http://127.0.0.1:${MULTICA_BOARD_WEB_PORT}" MULTICA_CODEX_PATH="${MULTICA_BOARD_CODEX_PATH}" MULTICA_CODEX_SHARED_HOME="${MULTICA_BOARD_CODEX_SHARED_HOME:-false}" MULTICA_CODEX_ISOLATED_HOME="${MULTICA_BOARD_CODEX_ISOLATED_HOME:-true}" CODEX_HOME="${MULTICA_BOARD_CODEX_HOME}" MULTICA_DAEMON_ID="multica-board-local" MULTICA_DAEMON_DEVICE_NAME="${MULTICA_BOARD_DEVICE_NAME:-Multica Board}" MULTICA_WORKSPACE_ID="${MULTICA_BOARD_WORKSPACE_ID}"; exec "{{BIN}}" daemon start --foreground --daemon-id multica-board-local --no-auto-update --no-auto-reload
